cohort: surgen_msi_cohort.csv: all 32 MMR-deficient SR386 cases plus 96 MMR-proficient cases drawn at random (pandas sample, random_state=20261116); one slide per case; primary resections
features: same rules as TCGA: 0.5 um/px, 224 px tiles, HSV tissue mask, random cap 4,000 tiles seed 0, Phikon + UNI v1, mean-pooled. Differences: Zeiss CZI read with pylibCZIrw at 2x oversampling then area-resized; scanner and file format differ from TCGA
label: mmr_loss_binary (immunohistochemistry). Training label was sequencing-based MSI (MANTIS), so the label definitions differ
missing_slides: slides that fail download or embedding are reported and excluded; no replacement sampling
model: msi_model_frozen.npz: the MSI model already evaluated on CPTAC-COAD (standardised mean-pooled features, logistic regression C=1.0, balanced class weights, fitted on TCGA dev); applied unchanged as score = features . w + b
no_tuning: no threshold, recipe or cohort change after the labels are joined to the scores
primary_metric: AUROC with 2000-draw bootstrap percentile 95% CI, seed 0, reported for both encoders
secondary: confounder check: AUROC of tissue tile count alone
task: MSI / mismatch-repair deficiency, external validation on SurGen SR386 (single look)
